the kingdom
 of Divine

 as

 from

most and

 one

 it.

 and
 the
 perceived

 of

 out
ward;

 itself
 per
ceptible through

 proce
eding.

ment. The
 celest
ial nourishment that

 Good,

ounded together

 within
 the soul
. The sphere
 of spiritual perception that

unds them

eding,

ial beauty

 and
 is
 received
 —

 state
 which

utes the kingdom
 of Divine Wisdom.

 life
 is in

.


**¶6:** Just as
 all celest
ial goods
,

 abundant

owledges of truth, and all spiritual

 the Divine
 —

 of
 which

 called
 forth from the Divine
 itself
 — so

 states of love toward the Lord,
 and all origins of truth, and all
 perceptions of good and truth spring
 forth and
 flow abund
antly from that
 same
 source
. Everything
 the
 Divine brings
 forth is imm
easurably great
.
 Every
 reality
 you
 perceive within
 this
 kingdom
 is
 neither
 merely
 natural truth
 nor…

ishes between the

water

natural

.

**¶8:** The
 full
ness of Divine
 Wisdom,

 the sphere
 of spiritual life and
 perception in

 states

eding dwell —

joined ther
ein,
 established
 beyond
 change
. The spiritual
 intelligences that
 minister
 within

 that

 into
 them
 as
 infl
ux of
 good from the Divine itself
 — all
 ab
ide within
 this
 living
 order
.


**¶9:** A
 state
 of blessedness belongs
 to whoever
 receives
 this
 wisdom interiorly and
 makes
 it his
 own.
